verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents several in-product AI features that draw on the user's own mailbox. Ask AI generates succinct answers from inbox data. Auto Labels classify incoming mail, including custom prompt-defined labels. Auto Drafts 2.0 proposes replies using context from the inbox, calendar and web, and the assistant raises proactive follow-up reminders. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI features, and explicit evidence of in-product thread summaries or broader analytical insights (summarization is only documented via external assistants over MCP).
